```{r}
#| label: load-packages
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
highschool_attainment <- read_xlsx(
  here::here("data/hst_attain02.xlsx"),
  range = "A7:D75",
  col_names = c("year", "total", "male", "female")
)

bachelors_attainment <- read_xlsx(
  here::here("data/hst_attain02.xlsx"),
  range = "A77:D145",
  col_names = c("year", "total", "male", "female")
)

earnings <- read_xlsx(
  here::here("data/hst_attain03.xlsx"),
  range = "A7:P56",
  col_names = c(
    "year", 
    "total_number_earnings", "total_mean", "total_std_error", 
    "none_number_earnings", "none_mean", "none_std_error", 
    "hs_number_earnings", "hs_mean", "hs_std_error",
    "associate_number_earnings", "associate_mean", "associate_std_error",
    "bachelor_number_earnings", "bachelor_mean", "bachelor_std_error")
) %>%
  select(1:4,14:16)

enrollment_cost <- read_xlsx(
  here::here("data/tabn330.10.xlsx"),
  range = "A7:P56",
  col_names = c(
    "academic year", 
    "total_cost_all", "total_cost_4_year", "total_cost_2_year",
    "tuition_cost_all", "tuition_cost_4_year", "tuition_cost_2_year",
    "dorm_cost_all", "dorm_cost_4_year", "dorm_cost_2_year",
    "board_cost_all", "board_cost_4_year", "board_cost_2_year",
    "total_cost_all_constant", "total_cost_4_year_constant", "total_cost_2_year_constant")
) %>%
  select(1:2,14)

glimpse(highschool_attainment)
glimpse(bachelors_attainment)
glimpse(earnings)
glimpse(enrollment_cost)

```
